summary: Ituran Location & Control Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on October 20, 2026, attaching a press release that schedules its third-quarter 2026 earnings release and a Zoom conference call for November 24, 2026. The filing is a routine results-date announcement, not a transactional event. No terms, pricing, stake, board recommendation, advisors, or structural mechanics are disclosed. The exhibit includes standard corporate background on the company's telematics business and subscriber base, with a replay link provided. No special-situations angle; no deal terms to track.
